ipAddresses.heading: IP addresses
ipAddresses.body: When you sign in, we store your device's IP address with the session so we can check suspicious sign-ins to your account. We remove the address no later than 30 days after sign-in, and we delete an expired session entirely. To prevent abuse we also use your IP address briefly to limit repeated attempts: about a minute for sign-in and similar actions, and up to 24 hours for the contact form, kept only in the server's memory. When a secure connection to our server fails, the server's error log records the address of that connection. We use those entries only to fix faults. Database backups may hold this data for up to 60 more days. The legal basis is legitimate interest (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).

errorTracking.heading: Error tracking
errorTracking.collected: When something breaks in the app, we send technical details to Sentry, our processor, which stores them in the European Union: the error, your browser and device, the page address and your account's internal ID. Sentry doesn't store your IP address, but it may work out an approximate location (country, sometimes city) from the connection. We don't attach your name or email to events, but a failed sign-in or sign-up request may include the email address you typed.
errorTracking.replay: For a small share of visits, and for visits with an error, we also record a session replay with all text and input hidden. Passwords, tokens and session cookies are removed before sending. We use this data only to fix errors. Sentry keeps it for at most 30 days. The legal basis is legitimate interest (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).
